'''Goss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was present at a party on Kaas City, the same party that [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash]] attended to cover up her trace of planning [[Darth Skotia]]'s assassination, which [[Darth Nox|her apprentice]] eventually executed.
